verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's feature page states that teams can create a shared source of truth that includes context from their docs and repositories, which matches the story almost word for word. The only support is that one marketing line: there are no setup docs and no corroboration. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the shared workspace is created and managed (which doc sources are supported, sharing and permission controls), hands-on or independent corroboration.
